subject: Pillar Health — sequencing for UK Addendum, subprocessor tiers, and evidence gating
messages:
From: Claire Hargreaves <claire@pillarhealth.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.inference <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
Cc: Pillar Health Legal <legal@pillarhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: UK addendum sequencing + evidence gating (Pillar Health)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week — Pillar Health is excited to move to a short pilot. Our legal team asked me to consolidate the asks so we can get the UK Addendum signed and evidence gated in parallel. Key items: 

- UK Addendum: we need to understand signing order (can DocuSign be staged so we sign the UK Addendum first, then the main DPA?).
- Evidence gating: we will require a tranche of operational evidence (SOC2 summary, subprocessor list, KV-cache residency confirmation) before we move production data. We can accept a staged delivery (pilot staging -> full prod) but need clear milestones.
- Subprocessor tiers: to satisfy our audit, we need a simple tiering schedule showing which subprocessors touch unredacted PHI (if any) and which are purely infra-level.
- Escrow / holdback: our procurement wants an escrow holdback clause if evidence is delayed >30 days.

I attached a quick worksheet with the evidence items. Can you please confirm Redwood's sequencing preference and whether you can provide a tiered subprocessor matrix? Also loop in anyone on your side who would own the technical evidence.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if easier.

Claire Hargreaves
Head of Data Privacy
Pillar Health

Attachment: PillarHealth_TIA_Request_20260820.xlsx (xlsx)

From: jordan_blake@redwood.inference <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
To: Claire Hargreaves <claire@pillarhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.inference <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, laura_bennett@redwood.inference <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: UK addendum sequencing + evidence gating (Pillar Health)

Claire — thanks for the clear worksheet and for outlining the asks. Looping in Kimberly (security) and Laura (legal) to confirm technical evidence and signing order. High-level response below and proposed "staircase" for execution: 

Proposed sequencing (staircase):
1) Execute UK Addendum (DocuSign signature request #1) — this commits both parties to the UK transfer terms; no production data yet.
2) Deliver baseline evidence package (SOC2 summary + subprocessor matrix + KV-cache residency note) within 10 business days of Addendum execution.
3) Pilot go-live (restricted dataset) — if evidence delivered and accepted, Pilot sign-off.
4) Execute Master DPA (DocuSign signature request #2) and flip environment to prod.

We can stage DocuSign so the Addendum is routed to Pillar first, then Redwood signs, and the DPA envelope follows after evidence acceptance. For escrow/holdback: we do support a limited holdback clause for material evidence delays but need procurement terms (cap and trigger language).

Kimberly — can you confirm the items in Pillar's worksheet match what our security team will provide as the baseline? In particular: 
- SOC2 summary (redacted report + monitoring cadence)
- Current subprocessor list with a simple "tier" column (touches data plane vs infra only)
- Confirmation of KV-cache residency (region and retention)

Laura — do we have standard phrasing for the staged DocuSign and the limited holdback clause? If not, I can ask Pillar to accept a short form we use for pilots.

Happy to set a 30-min call with Pillar next week; Claire, what times are best?

— Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0139

From: kimberly_park@redwood.inference <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.inference <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.inference <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>, Claire Hargreaves <claire@pillarhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: UK addendum sequencing + evidence gating (Pillar Health)

Jordan / Claire — quick technical confirm and an ask from security. Summary: 

- SOC2: we can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II attestation and our SOC2 monitoring cadence doc within 7 business days of Addendum signing.
- Subprocessor tiering: attached is a short matrix that maps subprocessors to processing role (data-plane, control-plane, monitoring). We will add a "touches PHI" boolean for your auditors where applicable.
- KV-cache residency: Redwood's KV-cache is region-bound per deployment; for Pillar's EU/UK pilot we will pin instances to UK/EU and retain caches for max 48 hours by default unless a longer TTL is requested and approved.

One operational caveat: for a staged pilot -> prod flow we ask for written acceptance of the baseline evidence before we enable production keys. That acceptance can be a single-line email from your privacy or procurement lead. If you need an independent attestor (third-party escrow) for the holdback clause, give us target language; otherwise we can propose Redwood's standard escrow trigger: evidence overdue > 30 days after Addendum, capped at 5% of first-year committed spend, remediated within 60 days or funds used for certified remediation.

Attachment: subprocessor-tiering-matrix.pdf (pdf)

Happy to hop on the call if Pillar wants to walk through the matrix.

— Kimberly Park
Sr. Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.inference <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Claire Hargreaves <claire@pillarhealth.com>, jordan_blake@redwood.inference <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.inference <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: UK addendum sequencing + evidence gating (Pillar Health)

Claire / Jordan / Kimberly — thanks, this is actionable. A few legal notes and next steps: 

- Signing order: Redwood is fine staging the DocuSign envelopes as Jordan proposed. We will prepare two envelopes: (A) UK Addendum (sign first), (B) Master DPA (conditional on evidence acceptance). Please confirm Pillar's signer for the Addendum (name + email) so we can route envelope A.
- Holdback clause: Redwood legal can accept a limited escrow holdback. Proposed draft language: "If baseline evidence as set out in Annex A is not delivered within 30 days of Addendum execution, Pillar Health may draw on an escrowed remediation fund equal to up to 5% of the first-year committed subscription fee, subject to a 60-day remediation cure period." If Pillar proposes alternative caps or a different trigger, send redline.
- Evidence acceptance: a single-line acceptance email from your Head of Privacy (Claire) or Procurement will suffice to move to production. We will record timestamps in our onboarding runbook.

I attached a redline for our UK Addendum with the staircase language inserted; it's mostly boilerplate but adds the conditional signing flow. If Pillar confirms the signer and is comfortable with the holdback cap above, Jordan can send the DocuSign envelope. Otherwise, please redline and return.

Next steps checklist:
- Claire: confirm Addendum signer and any requested changes to the holdback cap/trigger (reply here).
- Pillar Legal: redline UK Addendum if needed — otherwise sign envelope A when received.
- Jordan: prepare DocuSign envelopes and proposed pilot acceptance template (one-line acceptance).
- Kimberly: hand off baseline evidence deliverables to Jordan with expected delivery dates.

Attachment: redlined-UK-Addendum-v2.docx (docx)

Best —
Laura Bennett
Head of Privacy & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
